title: Multi-step service request form completion success
description: Verify that a user can successfully complete all steps of the multi-step online assistance request form with valid inputs and receive a confirmation message.

steps.description: Navigate to the service request form starting page
Input a valid vehicle plate number without spaces or special characters
Input a valid national ID number
Provide location via GPS (simulate permission granted)
Proceed to problem selection step
Select an issue type from dropdown (Breakdown, Accident, Out of Fuel)
Review request summary page
Submit the service request form
Check that confirmation message appears indicating rescue team dispatched

title: Multi-step form validation for license plate input
description: Ensure license plate input validation enforces format rules disallowing spaces or special characters and requires non-empty input.

steps.description: Navigate to the license plate entry step in the multi-step form
Enter license plate with spaces or special characters
Attempt to proceed to next form step
Verify validation error message shows for invalid license plate
Enter an empty license plate input
Attempt to proceed further
Verify mandatory field validation error message appears

title: Location input validation when GPS permission denied
description: Verify that when GPS permission is denied, manual location input is mandatory and must be validated before form submission.

steps.description: Start service request form and deny GPS location permission
Leave manual location input empty
Attempt to proceed to next step
Confirm validation error message requiring location input is displayed
Enter a valid manual location (city and district)
Proceed to the next step
Confirm form allows proceeding after valid location input

title: Insurance policy limits and benefits progress bar display
description: Check that after user login, insurance or assistance package limits and remaining benefits are correctly displayed with intuitive progress bars.

steps.description: Login as a user with active insurance policies
Navigate to insurance policy limit page
Verify progress bars display correct usage and remaining benefits visually
Verify data matches API responses and updates on data refresh

title: Admin login success and role-based access control enforcement
description: Verify admin users with roles SUPER_ADMIN, ADMIN, and EDITOR can log in successfully and have their permissions accurately enforced.

steps.description: Attempt login with valid SUPER_ADMIN credentials
Confirm successful login and access to all admin features
Log out and login with valid ADMIN credentials
Confirm access to allowed admin features and restricted areas are blocked
Log out and login with valid EDITOR credentials
Confirm restricted permissions reflecting role, cannot edit packages or delete content
Attempt unauthorized action for each role (e.g., EDITOR trying to delete a package)
Check system denies the action with proper error or UI restriction

title: Admin panel CRUD operations for road assistance packages
description: Verify that admin users can create, read, update, and delete road assistance packages with all required validations and UI updates.

steps.description: Login as admin (SUPER_ADMIN or ADMIN)
Navigate to packages management page
Create a new package with valid data
Confirm package is saved and visible in the list
Edit the created package details
Confirm updates are saved and reflected immediately
Delete the created package
Confirm package is removed from list and database
Try creating a package with missing mandatory fields
Verify proper validation error messages appear

title: Admin panel CRUD operations for road assistance services
description: Verify admin users can fully manage services including towing, battery support, tire, and fuel services with all CRUD operations and validations.

steps.description: Login as admin user
Open services management page
Create a new service with all required valid fields
Confirm new service is listed and details are correct
Edit the service details
Verify changes saved and displayed accurately
Delete the service
Confirm service is removed successfully
Try creating a service without mandatory fields
Check validation errors are triggered and user is notified

title: Hero slider management with image upload and content editing
description: Verify admin users can upload images via Vercel Blob, create, edit, and delete hero slider items with correct content displayed on the homepage.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to hero sliders management page
Create a new slider item by uploading an image with supported format
Input slider content such as headline and subtext
Save the new slider item
Confirm slider appears in admin list and on homepage hero section after refresh
Edit the slider content and replace image
Verify updates appear correctly on homepage
Delete a slider item
Confirm removal from both admin and public views

title: Email notifications on application submission
description: Ensure that when users submit assistance applications, the system sends email notifications via Resend API successfully and catches errors gracefully.

steps.description: Submit a multi-step service request form successfully
Verify email notification is sent to user and admin email addresses via Resend API
Simulate Resend API failure during email sending
Check system logs error and shows a user-friendly message without form data loss

title: Responsive design verification across devices
description: Validate that the responsive web platform UI works flawlessly on various device viewports from iPhone SE up to 4K monitors with no layout break or overflow.

steps.description: Open the website home page on devices/emulated screen sizes: iPhone SE, iPhone 13 Pro, iPad, desktop 1080p, and 4K monitor
Check that all UI elements including buttons, forms, menus, and layout respond correctly without horizontal scroll or overlapping
Verify Tailwind CSS utility classes apply expected styling and spacing at each breakpoint

title: Accessibility compliance with WCAG 2.1 AA standards
description: Verify all buttons, inputs, and interactive elements have proper aria-labels and color contrast meets WCAG 2.1 AA level requirements.

steps.description: Run accessibility audit suite (e.g., axe) on home page and service request forms
Confirm no violations on aria-labels, focus order, keyboard navigation, and color contrast
Manually verify buttons, inputs and navigation elements have meaningful screen reader labels

title: SEO structured data and sitemap verification
description: Verify that the site includes correct structured data markup according to Schema.org, sitemap.xml is complete and robots.txt disallows unwanted crawling.

steps.description: Access homepage source and verify presence of valid JSON-LD structured data
Check structured data validates without errors using Google Structured Data Testing Tool
Fetch sitemap.xml and verify all relevant pages are listed
Confirm sitemap URLs are accessible and contain timestamps
Fetch robots.txt and verify it includes correct directives for search engine bots

title: Graceful error handling on insurance policy data API failure
description: Ensure the UI shows a friendly error message instructing users to call support if the insurance policy data API is unavailable or returns an error.

steps.description: Simulate insurance policy data API failure scenario
Navigate to insurance policy limit check page as logged-in user
Verify user sees a clear error message instructing to contact support by phone
Confirm no unhandled exceptions or UI crashes occur

title: Loading states with skeleton loaders and spinners
description: Verify that proper loading indicators like skeleton loaders or spinners appear during data fetching or API call latency periods across critical user flows.

steps.description: Trigger loading states by throttling network or mocking API delays on service request form data dropdowns
Confirm skeleton loaders or spinner animations display clearly and disappear once data loads
Navigate through admin pages with data fetching (packages, services, applications)
Verify consistent loading states appear before content renders

title: Global search functionality in admin panel
description: Validate that the global search input returns relevant results instantly for users, packages, and services and supports notifications filtering.

steps.description: Login as admin and access global search input
Enter valid keywords matching user names, service titles, and package names
Check that search results display matching items categorized by type
Filter notifications using search field
Verify notifications list updates correctly matching the query

title: Statistics API returns accurate application counts and KPIs
description: Test that the admin dashboard statistics API returns correct application counts and relevant KPIs reflecting recent data accurately.

steps.description: Login as admin and make requests to statistics API endpoint
Verify response contains correct counts for application submissions in various time frames
Check accuracy of key performance indicators matches database state

title: Admin site settings update and visibility
description: Verify that admin users can update site settings including contact info, social media links, and working hours, and ensure changes reflect on the public site.

steps.description: Login as admin and navigate to site settings page
Modify contact phone, email, social media URLs, and working hours
Save changes
Confirm settings persist after page refresh and in database
Visit public site pages to verify updated contact info and working hours appear
